fail_closed_rules: Employment land need and economic-development evidence are strategic inputs; they do not establish parcel allocation, planning permission, deliverability or a Future Growth score.
An employment allocation or proposed allocation does not establish planning permission, current occupancy, legal title, site control or implementation.
A zero-record or no-attempt Planning Data employment-allocation dataset is NO_DATA only and never proves that no employment allocation exists.
Town-centre status, hierarchy or a mapped boundary does not by itself determine proposal acceptability.
Passing a sequential test is not planning permission and does not resolve other development-plan policies or site-specific constraints.
A failed or disputed sequential test can be material but remains proposal-, use-, evidence- and policy-specific rather than a generic parcel refusal score.
Retail and leisure impact assessment is not universally required; applicable scale thresholds, location, use and development-plan policy must be checked.
An impact-assessment threshold is an assessment trigger, not an approval, refusal or Future Growth score.
Town-centre vitality, vacancy, footfall, expenditure, turnover and trade-diversion evidence is time-sensitive contextual evidence and is not parcel permission.
Main town-centre uses, offices, industrial and logistics uses, retail, leisure and mixed uses must remain separate classifications rather than being collapsed into one employment-use label.
Strategic Industrial Locations, Locally Significant Industrial Sites and non-designated industrial land are distinct categories whose current policy and boundaries require separate verification.
SIL or industrial designation does not establish ownership, lease rights, access rights, developable capacity or permission.
Historical London Plan industrial policies, benchmarks and boundaries are provenance evidence only and must not override current adopted policy.
The July 2026 Draft London Plan is emerging policy and must not be represented as the adopted London Plan.
Draft, consultation-stage and emerging allocations or place visions remain separate from adopted statutory policy until the relevant plan-making process is completed.
Industrial intensification or co-location potential is an evidence and design proposition, not permission or guaranteed capacity.
Loss, release or substitution of industrial land requires current policy and local evidence; historic release trends do not prove a current release decision.
Industrial land studies, monitoring reports and theoretical capacity estimates are evidence inputs rather than parcel consent, valuation or implementation evidence.
Employment projections depend on scenario, methodology, geography, sector definitions and base dates and must not be converted directly into parcel development probability.
GLA long-term employment projections are modelled assumptions rather than committed jobs, floorspace or development at a specific site.
Medium-term economic forecasts are contextual macroeconomic evidence and do not prove parcel demand, rent, viability or planning permission.
BRES-style workplace employment, business counts, employee jobs and jobs-density aggregates are area statistics and must not be downscaled into parcel facts.
VOA business-floorspace statistics cover defined non-domestic rating data and must not be treated as a complete commercial-property inventory.
Rateable value and aggregated floorspace do not equal market value, market rent, vacancy, ownership, planning status or parcel development capacity.
Industrial Strategy sector status is national economic-policy context and does not create local planning support, site designation or consent.
Sector plans, Jobs Plans and national targets state policy ambitions and interventions; they do not prove site-specific demand, funding, delivery or permission.
Current 2026 indicators and year-one updates can supersede earlier baselines; publication date, definitions and methodology must be preserved when comparing them.
Design-code area types and archived planning-consideration schema pages are digital-design or data-model evidence and must not be treated as operative town-centre boundaries.
Duplicate government portals or mirrors of the same underlying dataset are not independent corroboration and must not inflate confidence or source counts.
No parcel relation, Future Growth score, business row or source promotion may occur while RECOVERY_PARKED persists, predecessor is incomplete and business execution remains forbidden.
